title: The Luxor Temple back chamber, reserved for Amenhotep to connect with Amun-Ra

tellings.quote: That huge chamber in the back, as far as we know, was reserved only for Aman Hotep to connect to his father, Aman Rah, the the god.

plain: A huge chamber at the back of Luxor Temple in Egypt was, as far as is known, reserved only for the pharaoh Amenhotep, so he could connect with his father, the god Amun-Ra. The researcher Luke Caverns, who has been there, tells it as the temple's purpose.
